name: [OPS] Admin Incident Alert - Telegram
description: Receives unhandled failures from selected production workflows and sends a concise Telegram alert to administrators. It deliberately excludes execution payloads and secrets from the message.

nodes.name: Send incident alert to admins
nodes.notes: After import, select the Telegram API credential and replace the chat ID placeholder. Do not include the failed execution payload, tokens, or personal data in this alert.
